report_name: Kempinski Hotels Guests Targeted by Phishing After Vendor Breach

attack_patterns.name: Trusted Relationship
attack_patterns.description: The initial vector was the compromise of a third-party technology partner, abusing the trusted relationship with Kempinski Hotels to access guest data.

attack_patterns.name: Spearphishing Link
attack_patterns.description: Attackers are sending fraudulent payment requests to guests via email, SMS, and WhatsApp, containing links designed to defraud victims.

attack_patterns.name: Spearphishing Attachment
attack_patterns.description: The phishing campaigns use stolen reservation data to appear highly convincing and may involve malicious attachments to defraud victims.

attack_patterns.name: Impersonation
attack_patterns.description: Attackers are posing as Kempinski Hotels in phishing messages sent to guests, using legitimate booking details to make the impersonation more convincing.

campaigns.name: Kempinski Guest Phishing Campaign
campaigns.description: A sophisticated phishing campaign targeting guests of Kempinski Hotels, using their stolen reservation data to send fraudulent payment requests for financial gain.

identities.name: Kempinski Hotels
identities.description: Luxury hotel group whose guests were targeted in a phishing campaign following a data breach at an unnamed third-party technology partner.

identities.name: Hotel Adlon Kempinski Berlin
identities.description: A specific Kempinski hotel whose guests are known to be affected by the phishing campaign.

infrastructure.name: Phishing Campaign Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Infrastructure used by attackers to send phishing messages via email, SMS, and WhatsApp to Kempinski guests.
